The activity requires setting up automatic synchronization to detect when policies/procedures are updated in source systems and flag outdated wiki references. This is fundamentally a **change data capture and notification orchestration** capability, not a standard CRUD operation on master data or analytical read.

While several candidates are ITSM/change management related (ChangeRequestApprovalWorkflow, SafetyChangeGovernance, etc.), none of them provide:
- Change notification/event streaming from source systems
- Wiki content update/flagging capabilities
- Data synchronization orchestration
- Automated policy/procedure update detection

The candidates are either:
- **Agents** that analyze incidents (not relevant to policy sync)
- **APIs** for managing changes/approvals (operational, not synchronization infrastructure)
- **Data products** for analytics (not for real-time sync and flagging)

This activity requires a CDC, event streaming, or integration orchestration resource type not represented in the candidates—returning an empty array is more accurate than forcing a tangentially related match.
